Meta.title: DocAgent
Meta.description: Ask questions about your own documents and get cited answers.

Landing.title: Ask your documents, get cited answers
Landing.description: DocAgent reads the PDF, Word, text and Markdown files you upload and answers your questions with quotes and page references, so you can check every claim. It can also summarise a document or compare two.
Landing.signInRequired: You need an account to use DocAgent. Create one or sign in to continue.

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.draftNotice: This is a placeholder. The final privacy text is added before the public launch.
Privacy.demo: In demo mode, your questions and the matching document excerpts are sent to a free third-party model that may log them.
Privacy.byok: If you add your own provider key, your questions and excerpts go to the provider you choose.
Privacy.originals: Original files are not kept after they are processed.
Privacy.cookies: The site uses a session cookie once you sign in, short-lived cookies while you register or sign in with Google or GitHub, and a language cookie. Your theme choice is kept in your browser's local storage. There is no analytics and no tracking.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

Error.title: Something went wrong
Error.description: An unexpected error occurred. You can try again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.resetDone: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password.
signIn.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Sign in again.

externalErrors.email_not_verified: Google or GitHub has not verified your email address, so we cannot sign you in with it. Verify it with the provider, or sign in another way.
externalErrors.no_verified_email: The provider did not share a verified email address. Sign in with email and password instead.
externalErrors.external_login_failed: Signing in with Google or GitHub did not work. Try again, or use your email and password.

register.title: Create your account
register.description: Use your email and a password, or continue with Google or GitHub.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.sentTo: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to activate your account.
checkEmail.sent: We sent you a confirmation link. Open it to activate your account.
checkEmail.until: Until you confirm your email, documents and questions are not available.
checkEmail.spam: Nothing arrived? Look in the spam folder, then ask for a new link.
checkEmail.resent: If this address still needs confirming, we sent a new link.

confirm.title: Confirm your email

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.description: Enter your email. If we find an account with a confirmed email address, we send you a reset code.

forgot.haveCode: I already have a reset code

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.description: Enter your email, the code from the email, and a new password.
reset.codeHint: Copy the code exactly as it appears in the email.

errors.codeInvalid: The reset code is not valid.

errors.rule_symbol: The password needs a symbol, for example ! or #.
errors.rule_unique: The password needs more different characters.

errors.registerFailed: We could not create the account with these details.
errors.badCredentials: Email or password is incorrect, or the email is not confirmed yet.
